topic_title: Direct Speech - English Grammar (SBI PO Error Detection)

intro_payload.title: Direct Speech
intro_payload.subtitle: Master SBI PO Level Error Detection
learning_outcomes: Understand what Direct Speech is with real-life examples
Master all punctuation rules (inverted commas, commas, capitals)
Learn structure: Reporting Verb + Reported Speech
Handle all sentence types: Statement, Question, Command, Exclamation
Crack SBI PO level error detection patterns
Identify 15+ common exam traps in Direct Speech

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumne aaj apni mummy ko kya bola jab tum school ja rahe the?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Maine kaha, 'Mummy, mujhe 50 rupaye chahiye.'

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Perfect! Yahi hai Direct Speech! Jab tum kisi ke exact words, bilkul waise hi bolte ho jaise unhone bole the, toh woh Direct Speech kehlata hai. Tumne inverted commas (' ') ke andar apne exact words diye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab WhatsApp pe jab hum kisi ka message quote karte hain, woh bhi Direct Speech hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! [[Direct Speech | When we repeat the exact words spoken by someone, using quotation marks]] kehte hain. Example: Rahul said, 'I am going to Delhi.' Yahan 'I am going to Delhi' Rahul ke exact words hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, toh agar main kahun 'Rahul said that he is going to Delhi' toh?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Excellent question! Woh Indirect Speech hai, uska alag chapter hoga. Yahan notice karo - Direct Speech mein inverted commas (' ') ya double quotation marks (" ") zaroor hote hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! Toh quotation marks Direct Speech ki pehchaan hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Dekho kuch aur examples: 
1. Teacher said, 'Submit your homework tomorrow.'
2. She shouted, 'Help me!'
3. He asked, 'Where is my pen?'
Sab mein exact words inverted commas ke andar hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, newspaper mein bhi toh likhte hain - PM said, 'We will develop India.' Woh bhi Direct Speech?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Absolutely! News reports mein bahut use hota hai. Kyunki journalist exact words dikhana chahta hai jo PM ne bole. Isi liye inverted commas lagaye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya Sir! Par punctuation ke aur rules kya hain?

guess_payload.question: Raju, neeche 4 sentences hain. Batao kaunsa Direct Speech NAHI hai?

options.text: She asked me where I was going.

guess_payload.explanation: Option B mein inverted commas nahi hain, aur 'She asked me where I was going' Indirect Speech hai. Baaki sabhi sentences mein exact words inverted commas ke andar hain, isliye woh Direct Speech hain. ⭐ BPSC/SSC Trap: Inverted commas ki absence check karo!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 1/3: Choose the sentence in Direct Speech:

options.text: He told me that he was ill.
She said, 'I am very happy today.'
They informed us that the train was late.
Mother advised me to study hard.

quiz_payload.explanation: केवल Option B में inverted commas (' ') हैं और exact words 'I am very happy today' दिए गए हैं। बाकी सभी Indirect Speech हैं क्योंकि वहाँ 'that', 'to' का use है और inverted commas नहीं हैं। Direct Speech की पहली पहचान = Inverted Commas!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 2/3: Which sentence is CORRECTLY written in Direct Speech?

options.text: Ramesh said, I am going home.
Ramesh said: I am going home.

quiz_payload.explanation: Option C सही है। Direct Speech का सही structure: Reporting verb (said) के बाद comma (,) आता है, फिर inverted comma शुरू होती है। Option A में inverted commas ही नहीं हैं। Option B में comma missing है। Option D में colon (:) गलत है, comma चाहिए। ⭐ SBI PO Trap: Comma + Inverted Comma का combination देखो!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 3/3: Identify the error in: She said, 'i am ready.'
quiz_payload.explanation: Error है - 'i' को 'I' होना चाहिए। Direct Speech के अंदर पहला letter capital होता है (यहाँ 'I' personal pronoun है, वो हमेशा capital)। Inverted commas सही हैं, comma भी सही है। ⭐ SSC CGL/SBI PO Favorite Trap: Capitalization errors inside inverted commas!

milestone_payload.title: MODULE 1 COMPLETED! 🎉
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Shabash! Tumne Direct Speech ki pehchaan seekh li. Ab punctuation rules master karenge! 🔥

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab Direct Speech ki sabse important cheez - Punctuation! SBI PO aur SSC mein 60% errors yahi se aate hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, punctuation matlab commas, full stops, inverted commas - yeh sab?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Haan! Direct Speech mein 5 punctuation rules hain jo exam mein pakka aate hain: 
1. Inverted Commas (Quotation Marks)
2. Comma placement
3. Capital letter
4. Full stop/Question mark/Exclamation
5. Reporting verb ke baad punctuation

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ek-ek karke samjhaiye, confusing lag raha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
[[Inverted Commas | Quotation marks used to enclose exact spoken words]] do types ke hote hain:
• Single: 'I am happy.'
• Double: "I am happy."
Dono sahi hain, par ek hi sentence mein dono mix mat karo!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh 'I am happy." - yeh galat hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul galat! Opening aur closing dono same hone chahiye. Ya dono single (' '), ya dono double (" "). ⭐ SBI PO Trap: Mixed quotation marks!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Noted Sir! Aur kaunse words inverted commas ke andar aate hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Sirf exact spoken words inverted commas ke andar! Example:
✅ He said, 'I am tired.'
❌ He said, 'I am tired.'
Yahan 'He said' reporting part hai (bahar), 'I am tired' exact words (andar).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab reporting verb (said, asked, shouted) hamesha bahar rahega?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly! Reporting verb kabhi inverted commas ke andar nahi aata. Yeh SSC/Railway ka favorite trap hai:
❌ 'He said, I am going.'
✅ He said, 'I am going.'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaa! Toh comma kahan lagegi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Comma placement ke 2 cases hain:

**Case 1: Reporting clause pehle ho**
He said, 'I am happy.'
(comma reporting verb के बाद, inverted comma से पहले)

**Case 2: Reporting clause baad mein ho**
'I am happy,' he said.
(comma inverted comma के अंदर, closing से पहले)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Case 2 mein comma inverted comma ke andar?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Dekho carefully: 'I am happy,' he said. ← comma यहाँ closing inverted comma से पहले आई। Agar Case 1 type ho toh: He said, 'I am happy.' ← comma reporting verb के बाद।

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye to confusing hai Sir! Kaise yaad rakhu?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Trick: Comma hamesha reporting verb aur exact words ke beech mein aati hai!

• He said, 'I am happy.' (said aur I ke beech)
• 'I am happy,' he said. (happy aur he ke beech)

Bas yeh dhyan rakho - comma spoken words aur reporting part ko separate karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohhhh! Matlab comma separator ka kaam karti hai dono parts ko alag karne ke liye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Perfect understanding! ⭐ BPSC/SSC Trap: Students comma hi bhool jate hain:
❌ He said 'I am happy.'
✅ He said, 'I am happy.'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya! Ab capital letter ka rule?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Direct Speech के अंदर पहला letter हमेशा capital होता है:
✅ She said, 'I am fine.'
❌ She said, 'i am fine.'

Chाहे inverted comma के अंदर कोई भी sentence हो - Statement, Question, Command - पहला letter capital!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh 'He said, 'my name is Ram.' galat hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul galat! 'my' को 'My' hona chahिए: He said, 'My name is Ram.' ⭐ SBI PO/SSC CGL Error Detection mein yeh pakka aata hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur agar 'I' ho toh? 'I' toh already capital hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
'I' pronoun हमेशा capital ही रहता है - sentence के शुरू में हो या बीच में:
✅ He said, 'I am going.'
✅ He said, 'When I come, I will tell you.'

Par dhyan do - 'i' लिखना grammatically गलत है हर जगह, Direct Speech में तो bilkul नहीं!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Okay! Toh proper nouns (Ram, Delhi, India) ka kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Woh toh हमेशा capital:
✅ She said, 'Ram is my friend.'
✅ He said, 'I live in Delhi.'

Basic capitalization rules Direct Speech के अंदर भी follow होते हैं!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya Sir! Ab end mein kaunsa punctuation aata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Direct Speech के अंदर ending punctuation sentence type पर depend करता है:

1. **Statement** → Full stop (.)
   He said, 'I am fine.'

2. **Question** → Question mark (?)
   She asked, 'Where are you going?'

3. **Command/Request** → Full stop (.) या Exclamation (!)
   Teacher said, 'Sit down.'

4. **Exclamation** → Exclamation mark (!)
   He shouted, 'Help!'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ending punctuation inverted comma ke andar aayegi ya bahar?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Golden Rule**: Ending punctuation (full stop/question mark/exclamation) हमेशा inverted comma के अंदर आता है, बाहर नहीं!

✅ He said, 'I am going.'
❌ He said, 'I am going'.

✅ She asked, 'Where are you?'
❌ She asked, 'Where are you'?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab full stop/question mark लगाने के बाद closing inverted comma!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly! Yeh SBI PO mein sabse common error hai:
❌ He said, 'I am happy'.
✅ He said, 'I am happy.'

Full stop/question mark pहले, फिर closing inverted comma!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Noted! Punctuation complete hogaya?

navigation.button_text: Ek quiz se check karte hain ➔

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 1/3: Identify the CORRECTLY punctuated sentence:

options.text: He said, 'i am going to school.'
He said 'I am going to school.'
He said, 'I am going to school.'
He said, 'I am going to school'.

quiz_payload.explanation:
Option C सही है। Errors:
• Option A: 'i' capital 'I' होना चाहिए
• Option B: comma missing after 'said'
• Option D: full stop inverted comma के बाहर है (अंदर होना चाहिए)

⭐ SBI PO Pattern: सभी options में अलग-अलग punctuation errors होती हैं!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 2/3: Find the error: She asked, "Where are you going"?

options.text: Question mark should be inside quotation marks

quiz_payload.explanation:
Error: Question mark (?) inverted comma के बाहर है, अंदर होना चाहिए।

❌ She asked, "Where are you going"?
✅ She asked, "Where are you going?"

Double quotation marks (" ") सही हैं (single ' ' भी सही होते)। Comma भी सही है। ⭐ BPSC/RRB NTPC Trap: Question mark की position!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 3/3: Which sentence has correct comma placement?
quiz_payload.explanation:
Option B सही है: 'I am tired,' he said.

जब reporting clause बाद में हो, तो comma inverted comma के अंदर, closing से पहले आती है।

Errors:
• Option A: comma missing
• Option C: comma inverted comma के बाहर (अंदर होनी चाहिए)
• Option D: comma दो बार (एक ही चाहिए)

⭐ SSC CGL Favorite Trap!

milestone_payload.title: MODULE 2 COMPLETED! 🎊
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Punctuation ki galtiyan ab tum pakad loge! Ab structure samjhenge 🚀

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Raju, ab Direct Speech ka structure detail mein samjhte hain. Har Direct Speech sentence ke 2 parts hote hain:

1. **Reporting Clause** (Reporting Verb + Subject)
2. **Reported Speech** (Exact words inside inverted commas)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir example se samjhaiye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Dekho: **He said, 'I am happy.'**

• Reporting Clause = He said (subject + reporting verb)
• Reported Speech = 'I am happy.' (exact words)

Dono parts ko comma separate karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh reporting clause kabhi inverted commas ke andar nahi aata?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
[[Reporting Clause | The part of sentence that introduces the speaker and verb]] inverted commas के बाहर होता है। Isme होता है:

• Subject (He, She, Ram, Teacher)
• Reporting Verb (said, asked, replied, shouted, exclaimed)

Example:
• **Ram said**, 'I am fine.'
• **The teacher shouted**, 'Be quiet!'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, reporting verb sirf 'said' hi hota hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Nahi! Bahut saare hain:
• Statement ke liye: said, told, replied
• Question ke liye: asked, inquired, questioned
• Command ke liye: ordered, commanded, advised
• Exclamation ke liye: exclaimed, shouted, cried

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur reported speech kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
[[Reported Speech | The exact words spoken by someone, enclosed in quotation marks]] woh part hai jo inverted commas के अंदर होता है:

He said, **'I am going to Delhi.'**

Yahan 'I am going to Delhi.' = Reported Speech (exact words jo He ne bole)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh inverted commas ke andar jo bhi hai woh reported speech?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly! Reported speech mein कोई भी sentence हो सकता है:
• Statement: 'I am fine.'
• Question: 'Where are you?'
• Command: 'Sit down.'
• Exclamation: 'Wow! What a scene!'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, reporting clause sentence के बीच में भी आ सकता hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Haan! Reporting clause 3 positions mein आ सकता है:

**1. Beginning:**
He said, 'I am happy.'

**2. End:**
'I am happy,' he said.

**3. Middle (rare):**
'I am,' he said, 'very happy.'

Sabse common = Position 1 (beginning)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow! Toh punctuation har position mein alag hoga?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Yes! Beginning mein: comma reporting verb के बाद
End mein: comma inverted comma के अंदर
Middle mein: dono jagah comma!

⭐ SBI PO/UPSC Prelims Trap: Middle position punctuation!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya! Ab practice karni hai!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 1/3: Identify the Reporting Clause in: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.'
quiz_payload.explanation:
Reporting Clause = 'She said' (Subject + Reporting Verb), जो inverted commas के बाहर है।

Reported Speech = 'I will come tomorrow.' (exact words inside inverted commas)

⭐ BPSC/SSC Pattern: Reporting clause vs Reported speech identification questions आते हैं!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 2/3: Which sentence has reporting clause at the END?

options.text: He said that he was tired.

quiz_payload.explanation:
Option B में reporting clause 'he said' अंत में है।

Option A: Beginning में
Option C: Indirect Speech (Direct नहीं)
Option D: Middle position

⭐ Railway RRB NTPC/SSC CHSL में position-based questions आते हैं!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 3/3: Find the error: 'I am going to school' said Ram.

options.text: Full stop should be inside inverted commas

quiz_payload.explanation:
दो errors हैं:

1. Comma missing: 'I am going to school,' said Ram.
(जब reporting clause end में हो, comma inverted comma के अंदर चाहिए)

2. Full stop missing inside inverted commas

✅ Correct: 'I am going to school,' said Ram.

⭐ SBI PO Level Trap: Multiple errors in one sentence!

milestone_payload.title: MODULE 3 COMPLETED! 🏆
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Structure master ban gaye! Ab different sentence types dekhenge 🔥

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Raju, Direct Speech mein 4 types ke sentences ho sakte hain:

1. **Declarative** (Statement)
2. **Interrogative** (Question)
3. **Imperative** (Command/Request)
4. **Exclamatory** (Exclamation)

Har type ka अपना punctuation aur structure hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, yeh confusing lag raha hai! Ek-ek karke samjhaiye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! Pehle Statement (Declarative) देखते हain - sabse common type!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Okay Sir, ready!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Declarative Sentence (Statement)**: Simple information देता है, कुछ बताता है।

Reporting Verb: said, told, replied, stated, mentioned
Ending: Full stop (.)

Example:
He said, 'I am a student.'
She told me, 'I live in Delhi.'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh statement में हमेशा full stop (.) ही aayega end mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Haan! Statement = Full stop mandatory.

✅ Ram said, 'I am happy.'
❌ Ram said, 'I am happy!'
(यह exclamation है, statement नहीं)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya! Ab question type?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Interrogative Sentence (Question)**: Sawal पूछता है।

Reporting Verb: asked, inquired, questioned, demanded
Ending: Question mark (?)

Example:
She asked, 'Where are you going?'
He inquired, 'What is your name?'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, question mark inverted comma के अंदर आएगा?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Haan! Hamari Golden Rule याद है?

✅ She asked, 'Where are you?'
❌ She asked, 'Where are you'?

Question mark हमेशा closing inverted comma से पहले! ⭐ SBI PO/SSC का favorite trap!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Noted! Command type kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Imperative Sentence (Command/Request)**: Order या request देता है।

Reporting Verb:
• Command: ordered, commanded
• Request: requested, asked, begged
• Advice: advised, suggested

Ending: Full stop (.) या Exclamation mark (!)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, examples dijiye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Examples:
• Teacher ordered, 'Sit down.'
• He requested, 'Please help me.'
• Mother advised, 'Study hard.'
• Commander shouted, 'Fire!'

Dhyan do - subject (you) hidden होता है imperative mein!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaa! Last type exclamation?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Exclamatory Sentence (Exclamation)**: Strong emotion express करता है - joy, surprise, anger, pain!

Reporting Verb: exclaimed, cried, shouted, screamed
Ending: Exclamation mark (!)

Example:
He exclaimed, 'What a beautiful scene!'
She cried, 'Alas! I am ruined!'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, exclamation mark bhi inverted comma के अंदर?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Haan bilkul!

✅ He shouted, 'Help!'
❌ He shouted, 'Help'!

Saari ending punctuation (., ?, !) inverted comma के अंदर! ⭐ UPSC/BPSC का repeated trap!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Clear! Ab practice karte hain!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 1/3: Which sentence is CORRECTLY written as Direct Speech (Statement)?

options.text: He said, 'I am going to market'.
He said, 'I am going to market.'
He said 'I am going to market.'
He said, 'i am going to market.'

quiz_payload.explanation:
Option B सही है।

Errors:
• Option A: Full stop inverted comma के बाहर (अंदर होनी चाहिए)
• Option C: Comma missing after 'said'
• Option D: 'i' को 'I' capital होना चाहिए

⭐ SBI PO Pattern: Statement में full stop position + comma + capitalization तीनों check करो!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 2/3: Identify the sentence type: He exclaimed, 'What a wonderful day!'
quiz_payload.explanation:
यह Exclamatory sentence है क्योंकि:
1. Reporting verb 'exclaimed' है
2. Exclamation mark (!) है
3. Strong emotion (wonder) express हो रहा है
4. 'What a...' exclamatory phrase है

⭐ BPSC/Railway Pattern: Sentence type identify करना + reporting verb match करना!

quiz_payload.question: Quiz 3/3: Find the error: She asked, 'Where are you going.'

options.text: Full stop should be question mark

quiz_payload.explanation:
Error: 'Where are you going' एक question है, इसलिए full stop (.) की जगह question mark (?) होना चाहिए।

✅ Correct: She asked, 'Where are you going?'

'asked' सही reporting verb है questions के लिए। Comma भी सही है।

⭐ SSC CGL/SBI PO Trap: Question sentence में full stop लगा देना (wrong punctuation for sentence type)!

milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Statement, Question, Command, Exclamation - sab clear! Ab SBI PO level traps dekhenge 🎯

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab asli game shuru hota hai! SBI PO, SSC CGL, BPSC mein Direct Speech se 10+ common errors aate hain. Sabko ek-ek karke seekhenge!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, yeh सब याद कaise रखूं? Bahut ज़्यादा lag raha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tension mat lo! Main 10 most repeated errors bataunga with exam patterns. Tumhe sirf patterns samajhne hain, ratta nahi marna!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Okay Sir, शुरू kijiye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 1: Missing or Wrong Inverted Commas**

❌ He said, I am going.
✅ He said, 'I am going.'

❌ He said, 'I am going." (mixed)
✅ He said, 'I am going.' (both single)

⭐ SBI PO/BPSC mein 20% questions yeh error check karte hain!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab opening aur closing match honi chahiye, aur exact words pe hi lagani hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Perfect! Aur dhyan do - inverted commas sirf reported speech (exact words) pe, reporting clause (He said) pe nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Clear! Next error?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 2: Missing Comma after Reporting Verb**

❌ He said 'I am happy.'
✅ He said, 'I am happy.'

❌ She asked 'Where are you?'
✅ She asked, 'Where are you?'

Comma reporting verb (said, asked) के तुरंत बाद mandatory है! ⭐ Railway/SSC का #1 trap!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Agar reporting clause baad mein ho toh?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tab comma inverted comma के अंदर:

❌ 'I am happy' he said.
✅ 'I am happy,' he said.

Comma हमेशा दोनों parts (reporting + reported) को separate करती है!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Got it! Next?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 3: Wrong Capitalization inside Inverted Commas**

❌ She said, 'i am fine.'
✅ She said, 'I am fine.'

❌ He said, 'my name is ram.'
✅ He said, 'My name is Ram.'

Inverted commas के अंदर पहला letter capital + proper nouns capital! ⭐ SSC CGL/SBI PO में हर paper में आता है!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh 'I' pronoun toh हमेशा capital?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Haan, 'I' कहीं भी हो - शुरू, बीच, अंत - हमेशा capital:

✅ He said, 'I and my brother are going.'
✅ She said, 'When I come, I will tell you.'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Perfect! Aage chalein!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 4: Ending Punctuation Outside Inverted Commas**

❌ He said, 'I am happy'.
✅ He said, 'I am happy.'

❌ She asked, 'Where are you'?
✅ She asked, 'Where are you?'

Full stop/Question mark/Exclamation mark हमेशा inverted comma के अंदर, बाहर नहीं! ⭐ BPSC/UPSC का ultra-favorite trap!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab closing inverted comma से पहले punctuation?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly! Dekho sequence:

Statement: 'I am fine.' (full stop पहले, फिर closing ')
Question: 'Where are you?' (? पहले, फिर closing ')
Exclamation: 'Wow!' (! पहले, फिर closing ')

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Crystal clear! Next error?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 5: Wrong Reporting Verb for Sentence Type**

❌ He asked, 'I am fine.'
(Question verb + Statement sentence)
✅ He said, 'I am fine.'

❌ She said, 'Where are you?'
(Statement verb + Question sentence)
✅ She asked, 'Where are you?'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab reporting verb aur sentence type match hone chahiye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Bilkul!
• Statement → said, told, replied
• Question → asked, inquired
• Command → ordered, commanded, requested
• Exclamation → exclaimed, cried, shouted

⭐ SSC/Railway में verb-sentence mismatch 15% errors!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Noted! Aur errors?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 6: Confusing 'said to' and 'told'**

Direct Speech mein dono correct:
✅ He said to me, 'I am fine.'
✅ He told me, 'I am fine.'

Par यह wrong:
❌ He told to me, 'I am fine.'

'told' के साथ 'to' नहीं आता! ⭐ SBI PO/SSC CGL का classic trap!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! Toh 'said to' या 'told' - dono sahi, par 'told to' galat?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly!

✅ He said to Ram, 'I am going.'
✅ He told Ram, 'I am going.'
❌ He told to Ram, 'I am going.'

'told' already transitive verb hai, 'to' ki zaroorat nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Great! Next error?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 7: Double Punctuation**

❌ He said, 'I am happy.'. (full stop दो बार)
✅ He said, 'I am happy.'

❌ She asked, 'Where are you?'? (question mark दो बार)
✅ She asked, 'Where are you?'

Ending punctuation एक ही बार - inverted comma के अंदर! ⭐ Railway/BPSC trap!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab inverted comma के अंदर full stop/question mark dene के बाद बाहर फिर से नहीं देनी?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly! Sentence पूरी हो गई inverted comma के अंदर ही। बाहर कोई punctuation नहीं चाहिए।

✅ Correct ending: 'I am happy.'
❌ Wrong: 'I am happy.'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Clear! Aur patterns?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 8: Question Structure with Statement Punctuation**

❌ He asked, 'Where are you going.'
(Question structure + full stop)
✅ He asked, 'Where are you going?'

❌ She said, 'Are you fine.'
(Question + wrong verb + full stop)
✅ She asked, 'Are you fine?'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab agar sentence में 'Where/What/When/Why/How' hai ya structure question type hai, toh question mark mandatory?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Perfect! Aur reporting verb भी 'asked/inquired' hona chahiye, 'said' नहीं!

⭐ SBI PO Level Trap: Question words देखकर तुरंत:
1. Reporting verb check करो (asked?)
2. Ending punctuation (?) check करो!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Noted! Next?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 9: Exclamatory Sentence with Wrong Punctuation/Verb**

❌ He exclaimed, 'What a scene.'
(Exclamatory verb + full stop)
✅ He exclaimed, 'What a scene!'

❌ He said, 'Alas! I am ruined!'
(Strong emotion + wrong verb)
✅ He exclaimed, 'Alas! I am ruined!'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh 'What/How/Alas/Hurrah' jaise words हों तoh exclamation mark aur 'exclaimed/cried' verb?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exactly! Exclamatory indicators:
• Words: What, How, Alas, Hurrah, Oh, Ah
• Reporting verbs: exclaimed, cried, shouted
• Ending: Exclamation mark (!)

⭐ UPSC/BPSC में exclamatory sentences की errors आती हैं!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Great! Last error pattern?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Error 10: Multiple Errors in One Sentence (SBI PO Level)**

❌ He said 'i am going to Delhi'?

Errors:
1. Comma missing after 'said'
2. 'i' should be 'I'
3. Question mark wrong (statement hai)
4. Full stop inverted comma के अंदर चाहिए

✅ He said, 'I am going to Delhi.'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow! Ek sentence mein 4 errors! Exam mein kaise identify karun sab?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Systematic approach:
1. Inverted commas check (opening/closing match?)
2. Comma check (reporting verb के बाद?)
3. Capital letter check (पहला letter?)
4. Reporting verb check (sentence type match?)
5. Ending punctuation check (अंदर? सही type?)

Yeh 5 steps हर sentence पे apply करो!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Perfect checklist! Ab practice karna hai!

quiz_payload.question:
Quiz 1/3 (SBI PO Level): How many errors are in this sentence?

She said 'Where are you going.'
quiz_payload.explanation:
Three errors:

1. **Comma missing** after 'said'
2. **Wrong reporting verb**: 'said' should be 'asked' (question hai)
3. **Wrong ending punctuation**: full stop (.) की जगह question mark (?) होना चाहिए

✅ Correct: She asked, 'Where are you going?'

⭐ SBI PO Pattern: Multiple errors को identify करना + count करना!

quiz_payload.question:
Quiz 2/3 (SBI PO Level): Identify the error:

He told to me, 'i will come tomorrow.'
quiz_payload.explanation:
Two errors:

1. **'told to'** गलत है → 'told me' या 'said to me' होना चाहिए
   ('told' के साथ 'to' नहीं आता!)

2. **'i'** को capital 'I' होना चाहिए

✅ Correct options:
• He told me, 'I will come tomorrow.'
• He said to me, 'I will come tomorrow.'

⭐ SSC CGL/SBI PO Classic Trap: 'told to' combination!

quiz_payload.question:
Quiz 3/3 (SBI PO Level): Find ALL errors:

The teacher said, 'what a beautiful answer'!
quiz_payload.explanation:
Three errors:

1. **'what'** को 'What' capital होना चाहिए (sentence start)

2. **Exclamation mark (!) position**: inverted comma के बाहर है, अंदर होना चाहिए

3. **Reporting verb 'said'** गलत है → 'exclaimed' होना चाहिए (exclamatory sentence)

✅ Correct: The teacher exclaimed, 'What a beautiful answer!'

⭐ SBI PO Ultimate Trap: एक sentence में तीनों major errors!

milestone_payload.title: MODULE 5 COMPLETED! 🏅
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Sab error patterns clear! Ab Officer-level revision karte hain 💪

revision_points.point: Direct Speech = Exact words of speaker in inverted commas ('...') or ("..."). Example: He said, 'I am happy.'
Opening and closing must match (both single or both double). Only on exact words, NOT on reporting verb. ⭐ SBI PO Trap: Mixed commas ('...")

• Reporting clause FIRST → comma after verb: He said, 'I am fine.'
• Reporting clause LAST → comma inside inverted comma: 'I am fine,' he said.
First letter inside inverted commas = CAPITAL. 'I' pronoun always capital. Proper nouns (Ram, Delhi) always capital. ⭐ SSC/Railway Trap: 'i am fine' (wrong)

Full stop/Question mark/Exclamation mark INSIDE inverted commas, not outside!
✅ 'I am happy.'
❌ 'I am happy'. ⭐ BPSC/UPSC #1 Trap!

• Statement → said, told + Full stop (.)
• Question → asked, inquired + Question mark (?)
• Command → ordered, requested + Full stop (.)
• Exclamation → exclaimed, cried + Exclamation mark (!)

Verb must match sentence type:
❌ He asked, 'I am fine.' (verb-sentence mismatch)
✅ He said, 'I am fine.' ⭐ SSC/Railway 15% errors

✅ said to me / told me
❌ told to me
'told' already transitive, no 'to' needed! ⭐ SBI PO Classic Trap

Never use ending punctuation twice:
❌ He said, 'I am happy.'. (two full stops)
✅ He said, 'I am happy.'

1. Inverted commas (match?)
2. Comma after verb (present?)
3. Capital letter (first letter?)
4. Reporting verb (type match?)
5. Ending punctuation (inside? correct type?)
⭐ Use this for every sentence!

quiz_payload.question:
FINAL QUIZ 1/4 (BPSC Multi-Statement Level):

Statement I: In Direct Speech, the reporting verb must always come before the reported speech.

Statement II: Inverted commas are used only for questions and exclamations.

Which is correct?
quiz_payload.explanation:
Both statements are FALSE:

**Statement I False**: Reporting clause तीन positions में हो सकता है:
• Beginning: He said, 'I am fine.'
• End: 'I am fine,' he said.
• Middle: 'I am,' he said, 'very fine.'

**Statement II False**: Inverted commas सभी Direct Speech sentences में use होते हैं - statement, question, command, exclamation सभी में!

⭐ BPSC Pattern: Multi-statement Assertion-Reason questions!

quiz_payload.question:
FINAL QUIZ 2/4 (SBI PO Error Detection):

Find the sentence with NO error:

options.text: He told to me, 'I will come tomorrow.'
The teacher said, 'What a brilliant answer!'

quiz_payload.explanation:
Option D is CORRECT.

Errors in others:

**Option A**: 'told to' wrong → should be 'told me' or 'said to me'

**Option B**: Question mark (?) inverted comma के बाहर है → अंदर होना चाहिए: 'Where are you going?'

**Option C**: Verb mismatch → 'I am very happy' exclamatory नहीं है (statement है), 'exclaimed' की जगह 'said' होना चाहिए

**Option D**: सही है (though 'exclaimed' better होता, पर 'said' grammatically गलत नहीं है)

⭐ SBI PO Trick: सबसे कम गलत option को correct मानते हैं!

quiz_payload.question:
FINAL QUIZ 3/4 (UPSC Prelims Level):

Which of the following is/are CORRECTLY punctuated?

1. He said, 'I am going to Delhi.'
2. 'Where are you,' she asked?
3. The commander shouted, 'Fire!'
4. 'i will come tomorrow,' he told me.

Select the correct answer:
quiz_payload.explanation:
Only 1 and 3 are CORRECT.

**1. Correct**: He said, 'I am going to Delhi.' ✅

**2. Wrong**: Question mark inverted comma के बाहर
✅ Should be: 'Where are you,' she asked. (no question mark बाहर)
या: She asked, 'Where are you?'

**3. Correct**: The commander shouted, 'Fire!' ✅

**4. Wrong**: 'i' को 'I' capital होना चाहिए
✅ Should be: 'I will come tomorrow,' he told me.

⭐ UPSC Pattern: Multiple statements की correctness check!

quiz_payload.question:
FINAL QUIZ 4/4 (SSC CGL Ultimate Challenge):

Correct the sentence with MINIMUM changes:

'my teacher said what a brilliant student you are'!

options.text: My teacher said, 'What a brilliant student you are!'
My teacher exclaimed, 'What a brilliant student you are!'
'My teacher said, What a brilliant student you are!'
My teacher said 'what a brilliant student you are!'

quiz_payload.explanation:
**Option A** is the answer with MINIMUM changes:

Original errors:
1. 'my' → 'My' (capital)
2. Missing comma after 'said'
3. 'what' → 'What' (capital inside inverted commas)
4. Exclamation mark inverted comma के बाहर (अंदर चाहिए)

**Why not B?** 'exclaimed' better होता (exclamatory sentence के लिए), लेकिन 'said' grammatically गलत नहीं। Question says MINIMUM changes, इसलिए verb change करने की जरूरत नहीं।

**Why not C?** 'My teacher' inverted comma के अंदर (गलत)

**Why not D?** Comma missing + 'what' small letter

⭐ SSC CGL Trick: Minimum corrections वाला option चुनो!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
🎯 **BONUS: Last-Minute Exam Tips**

1. **SBI PO/SSC CGL**: 70% errors = punctuation position (comma, full stop, question mark की position)

2. **BPSC/UPSC**: Multi-statement questions में carefully पढ़ो - एक word का difference होता है

3. **Railway/BSSC**: 'told to' trap हर exam में आता है - immediately identify करो!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, exam mein time kam hota hai - sabse pहले kya check karun?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Priority Order** (10-second scan):

1️⃣ Inverted commas (present? match?)
2️⃣ Comma after reporting verb
3️⃣ Capital letter (first + 'I' + proper nouns)
4️⃣ Ending punctuation position (अंदर?)
5️⃣ Reporting verb-sentence type match

Isi order mein scan karo - 90% errors pakad loge!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Perfect Sir! Ab confident feel ho raha hai! 🔥

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
🔥 **PRO-LEVEL TRAPS** (SBI PO/UPSC Only)

**Trap 1**: 'He said to her' vs 'He told her'
Dono correct, par Indirect Speech mein 'told' preferred.

**Trap 2**: Question tags in Direct Speech:
'You are going, aren't you?' she asked. ✅
(Full question + tag, question mark एक ही बार!)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow! Question tag wala kabhi socha nahi tha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
**Trap 3**: Interrupted Direct Speech:
'I am,' he said with hesitation, 'very tired.'
(Dono jagah comma, dono parts मिलकर एक sentence)

**Trap 4**: Multiple sentences inside inverted commas:
He said, 'I am fine. How are you?' ✅
(दोनों sentences inverted commas के अंदर)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Yeh advanced patterns हैं! Officer-level! 💪
